svg.title: Stiffness-frequency screening grid
svg.desc: 1,694 retained cases; 137 negative savings; no interpolation or new evaluation

g.text: 1,694 retained cases; 137 negative savings; no interpolation or new evaluation
100 × (1 − positive mechanical power / no-spring power at the same frequency).
Negative values are worse; the colour scale is fixed at −60% to +60%.
